T15, tcb/test/promote.test.mjs T14, tcb/test/certify.test.mjs T14: the lock-busy case took the 'nothing written' snapshot before the test itself wrote run.lock (holdLock), so the test's own lock file read as a script write. The snapshot is now taken after holdLock; the script still must write nothing (exit 75 asserted unchanged).

T13b protocol-unreadable: the tamper was one appended space. CONTRACT 3.18 says the ledger names the sha256 of the frozen file's canonical bytes, and lib.currentProtocol accepts a raw-bytes or canonical match, so whitespace is not a change of the protocol. The test now changes the protocol's content (sesoi m1 -> 99, written canonically) and still requires exit 2 protocol-unreadable and no views. The spec's 'whose bytes do not hash' wording vs the contract's canonical sha is the unclear part.
